parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` within the `Artwork` package. Although the two methods — `CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests.fetchesCachedArtworkWithoutReleaseTitle` (line 593) and `CacheCoordinatorArtworkTests.skipsEmptyReleaseTitle` (line 649) — share a Jaccard similarity of ~0.71, they encode distinct behavioural scenarios (cached artwork without a release title vs. skipping an empty release title) that are intentionally separate test cases. Collapsing them into a shared helper would obscure the intent of each scenario and make test failures harder to diagnose.
